name: leo-search
description: Browser-free research for Codex with Exa, Context7, Jina, GitHub and safe local CLI routing.

interface.longDescription: Routes current web research, technical documentation, URL extraction, GitHub and media lookups through remote MCP or existing command-line tools. Ordinary search never opens Chrome or installs a headless browser.
interface.defaultPrompt: Research this with current sources using Leo Search, without opening a browser.
